verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments platform, since some payment platforms ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Mangopay as a hosted API service with a Sandbox environment, SDKs and hosted components, and nothing documents a self-hostable deployment of the core product. The SDKs are client libraries that call Mangopay's hosted API, not a way to run the product yourself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
